We are thrilled to announce that Greg Meyer has joined Luciq as our Chief Financial Officer (CFO).

Greg most recently served as Vice President of Finance at Freshworks (Nasdaq: FRSH), aiding the company in its evolution from a late-stage private entity to a public company. He brings nearly 25 years of experience, including time at AppDynamics (acquired by Cisco), Microsoft, and Tellme Networks (acquired by Microsoft).

‍

> "I’m excited to be collaborating with Omar, Moataz, and the Luciq team on the opportunity to build upon their successes to date and drive sustainable growth for the years to come." —Greg Meyer

‍

In the ever-growing mobile industry, our commitment to empowering mobile teams to deliver mobile excellence is the core of what we do. Luciq continues to serve 25,000 + of the world's largest mobile teams throughout the app lifecycle. As we further our mission, we are supported by an esteemed leadership team.

Throughout the last year, we've doubled down on our product innovation and shipped significant product updates like Session Replay, App Ratings and Reviews, and Release Management. Furthermore, Luciq had quite a big year in 2023, closing the best quarter, signing the biggest deal, and delivering the largest product expansion in the company's history, and having top-tier companies in sports betting, telecom, software, and travel put their trust in Luciq. We are very excited for the year ahead and looking forward to supporting more customers and shipping more products.

With Greg joining us as our CFO, he'll play a crucial role in fortifying our strategic financial direction, underscoring our dedication to innovation and leadership in the industry. We are confident that Greg has the perfect skill set to help us execute our goals, better oversee our finance team, and endure the constantly shifting demands of the business and the reality of the market.

Welcome to the Luciq team, Greg! We are thrilled to have you onboard and excited for what's to come!
